Ear infection, prescribed Doxycycline until the infection became immune to it, presumably because they didn't check the record before prescribing more.

Taking blood, told me it'd be fine I had doxycycline and later on assumed I'd need an MRI scan for fatty liver because of it.

recent interaction with them, they've messed it up.

ADHD diagnosis, they tell me I missed an appointment they never informed me of and mixed up my records with a woman with cancer, only noticing once they're on the phone with me and audibly reading the words "Ovarian cancer". This is on top of telling me they'd referred me and not even done that.

Ear infection, prescribed Doxycycline until the infection became immune to it, presumably because they didn't check the record before prescribing more.

Taking blood, told me it'd be fine I had doxycycline and later on assumed I'd need an MRI scan for fatty liver because of it.
